definitions: A type of innovation that involves minor changes or improvements to existing products, processes, or services, often within established frameworks and without fundamentally altering the core business model.
The regular and incremental development of new features, efficiencies, or applications within an existing technological or operational paradigm.
examples: The company focused on routine innovation to maintain its market share.
Many industries rely on routine innovation for continuous improvement.
Routine innovation can lead to significant long-term gains.
